about: The lock is rendered once per digest of its lines, the anchor it is read with, the day that decides what expired and what the judge has said: the same inputs read the render back.
A render read back is the render taken: its text, its standing, its forks, its grey, its refused and its vacuous lines are the same bytes.

cases.name: a second fold of an unmoved lock

red was: every fold of every place rendered the lock again and verified every signature it holds, for lines that had not moved since the last fold
